messages:
maria_partnerships: Quick sync — Orchid wants to publish an appliance SKU that bundles our marketplace hosting + their quantized model. Need clarity on escrow, redistribution grant, and what we show in UI.
orchid_partner: hi! we can provide quantized weights, a signed redistribution memo, and an escrow option for source weights. prefer minimal paperwork. timeline: aiming for launch in 6 weeks.
eli_legal: Short checklist: explicit redistribution grant (1-paragraph addendum), copy of upstream license, checksum for artifacts, contact for takedown notices, and export-control flag. If escrow used, contract must allow takedown & audit access for us.
ton y_ops: infra constraints: hosted images require signed SHA256 for blobs, a model-card JSON, and confirmation of any third-party runtime dependencies. Escrowed artifacts need verifiable seals (e.g., notarized hash).
amy_devrel: UX: marketplace card should show "hosting: orchid (hosted)" or "download-only" and a small "redistribution-clarified" badge with a hover link to the addendum. For escrowed source we show a lock icon and "escrowed: contact orchid".
marketplace-bot: scan 9012: preview bundle missing license.txt and redistribution_addendum.pdf -> failing preview checks. link: https://ci.internal/marketplace/scan/9012
orchid_partner: is notarized attestation acceptable instead of PGP? some contributors don't have keys.
eli_legal: For previews, notarized attestation is acceptable as temporary measure. For paid/GA hosting we need a cryptographic signature (PGP or similar) or an escrow contract that includes signature-by-escrow. We'll add fallback language to the addendum.
ton y_ops: sample minimal model-card we expect (for partner docs):
```
{
  "model_name": "orchid-6b-q4",
  "quantization": "4-bit-ptq",
  "weights_sha256": "<sha256>",
  "tokenizer": "sentencepiece",
  "hosting_memory_mb": "~4500"
}
```
amy_devrel: good. I'll draft marketplace copy for the badge and hovercard. Keep public text non-legal: "Redistribution confirmed by partner. See addendum."
maria_partnerships: Actions: eli -> draft 1-page addendum + escrow clause; tony -> small preflight script that validates checksum, license, and model-card; amy -> badge/hovercopy; orchid -> upload manifest + addendum for re-scan. Target: draft + demo preflight by next Tue.
orchid_partner: we'll upload manifest and addendum by EOD Mon. thanks all.
maria_partnerships: thanks team — if anyone sees edge cases (dual-licensed weights, embargoed datasets, third-party escrow custodians), flag here and we'll escalate to legal. :eyes:
